primaryPersona.name: Pieter Janssen
primaryPersona.title: Odoo Project Manager

demographics.experience: 5+ years in ERP implementation, 2+ as a PM
demographics.companySize: Works for an Odoo Partner or a mid-sized company using Odoo
demographics.techSavviness: High. Comfortable with various SaaS tools but frustrated by tool fragmentation

primaryPersona.quote: I feel like I live in back-to-back meetings. By the end of the week, I can't remember who approved which change or the exact steps I showed the client on Tuesday. It's all a blur, and the documentation is always a week behind.
motivations: Delivering projects on time and on budget
Being seen as an expert and trusted advisor
Finding ways to work smarter, not harder
goals: To maintain a perfect, up-to-date memory of every client interaction and decision across multiple projects
To reduce the time spent on manual, tedious tasks like writing meeting minutes and creating training documentation
To quickly onboard new team members to a project without having to re-explain everything
To have a single source of truth for each project that both he and his clients can trust
To proactively answer client questions by referencing exact moments in previous demos

painPoints.title: Project Amnesia
painPoints.description: Details from meetings (verbal agreements, on-screen demos) are lost almost immediately after the call ends

painPoints.title: Documentation Lag
painPoints.description: Manually creating step-by-step training guides or meeting summaries is time-consuming and often inaccurate because it relies on memory

painPoints.title: Context Switching Chaos
painPoints.description: Juggling multiple complex Odoo projects means details get mixed up, leading to confusion and errors

painPoints.title: He Said, She Said
painPoints.description: Disagreements arise over what was agreed upon because there is no easily searchable, objective record of conversations

painPoints.title: The What Was Said vs. What Was Shown Gap
painPoints.description: Standard audio transcripts miss the critical context of what was happening on-screen during a demo, which is often more important than the words spoken

wateringHoles: Events: Odoo annual events (like the one in Belgium) are a primary source for networking and discovering new tools
Online Communities: Odoo official forums, LinkedIn Groups for Odoo Professionals, specific subreddits
Publications: Follows Odoo-focused blogs and publications
Word of Mouth: Trusts recommendations from other Odoo partners and senior PMs in his network

howGoodooHelps.description: Goodoo.ai provides a perfect, queryable memory of every meeting, capturing both audio and visual context. Pieter can instantly find the exact moment a client approved a feature or the specific configuration he demonstrated last week.

Instead of spending hours writing guides, Pieter can now generate a detailed, step-by-step visual training document in minutes, directly from the meeting recording where he performed the demo. This saves time and eliminates errors.

With a dedicated, intelligent workspace for each project, Pieter can immerse himself in one project at a time. The AI is his dedicated project historian, ensuring he never mixes up details between Client A and Client B again.

When a disagreement arises, there's no more debate. Pieter can pull up the transcript, linked directly to the video, showing exactly what was said and shown, providing indisputable clarity for both his team and the client.
